thread:
julia-peopleops: Quick Q — manager asked for a promo override + title sync for an internal transfer, want to confirm the steps so we don't miss payroll cutoff.
lee-manager: Hi — this is for Priya K (eng). Current: IC2, requested: Sr IC, requested comp uplift to 145k (band midpoint is 138k). Effective date requested 2024-03-15.
sam-peopleops: Thanks, Lee. Two quick calls out: 1) if comp exceeds band, we need comp-committee signoff; 2) payroll cutoff matters for backpay.
julia-peopleops: Process summary — manager submits the promo-change form, attach evidence (1–2 bullets), cc people-ops. We then route to comp-committee if needed and create payroll ticket.
tess-peopleops: Evidence checklist: - concrete impact examples (quarter metrics / PRs) - peer calibration note or manager rubric - org chart snapshot showing scope change. Put those in the Google folder or attach to the form.
lee-manager: Ok — I have the doc with 3 bullet examples and a short calibration note. Which form URL again?
julia-peopleops: Use: https://hr.redwood/promo-change — fill "Requested effective date" and choose "Promo override" under reason. Subject line template: PromoOverride: <Name> / <Team> / <New Title> / <New Base>.
sam-peopleops: Payroll details: payroll cutoff is 2024-03-20 23:59 PT for the March cycle. If we have final approvals and the HRIS update before cutoff we can apply backpay to 3/15. If approvals are after cutoff we'll apply starting next cycle and retro will be handled as off-cycle backpay in the following payroll (expect one additional run). We also need final compensation approval recorded in the case notes for audit.
finance-bot: payroll-ticket-1234 created -> https://finance.redwood/tickets/1234 (assigned to payroll-team). Estimated resolution ETA 3 business days after approvals.
julia-peopleops: Comp-committee email: comp-committee@redwood.com. For overrides include: name, current band, requested comp, rationale, calibration note, manager sign-off. Typical turnaround 48–72 hours during weekdays.
tess-peopleops: If this is also a title-only sync (no comp change), mark "title sync" in form and we can do fast-track (usually 1 pay period). For comp increases, follow override flow.
lee-manager: Got it — I'll submit the form + folder tonight and ping here when done. Thanks! :thumbsup:
julia-peopleops: Thanks Lee — once you submit ping @julia-peopleops and we'll triage. If you need a template for the calibration note, use this quick blurb: "Priya expanded scope to lead the frontend infra initiative, delivering X% latency reduction and owning cross-team onboarding; peers agree on scope upgrade."
lee-manager: Copying that into the note now.
sam-peopleops: Side note — if new base triggers offer-equity adjustments for parity, reach out to compops. We can include a recommendation but equity decisions take a separate approval flow.
lee-manager: Noted. Submitting now.
finance-bot: payroll-ticket-1234 status -> awaiting-hris-update.
julia-peopleops: Follow-up: if comp-committee approves and we get approvals before cutoff we'll confirm final HRIS update time so you know whether backpay will hit the same cycle. We'll post updates here.
lee-manager: Great — thanks all.
